d: Indian Americans are making their mark in US politics, but the journey to political power comes with challenges. From the US Congress to state elections, Indian American politicians are fighting for representation while navigating racism, racial bias, online hate and fundraising hurdles. Ahead of the US Midterm Elections 2026, this special report explores how Indian Americans are reshaping American politics, breaking barriers and winning voters beyond their ethnic communities.
